en_title: 'There's No One Person That Has This Whole Thing in Their Head' — GTA 6 Devs Had Freedom to Add Cool Features Just Like RDR2's Horse Balls
subtitle: 没人能掌握全貌
opus_summary: Rockstar允许《GTA6》开发者自由添加有趣细节，连高层也未必尽知。《荒野大镖客：救赎2》中马匹睾丸遇冷收缩的细节同样出自开发者，并非预先规划。

paragraphs.en: Rockstar Games gave GTA 6 s' developers so much freedom to add cool details that not even the studio's top executives are aware of everything in the game.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar给予《GTA6》开发者充分的自由，让他们添加有趣的细节，以至于连工作室最高层也不清楚游戏里的全部内容。

paragraphs.en: The latest behind-the-scenes information on GTA 6 comes from Bloomberg reporter Jason Schreier, who expanded upon his trip to the Rockstar North offices in Edinburgh, Scotland, after previously sharing other highlights last week . One of the more noteworthy bits shared in his 18-minute video's runtime is that the team who spent a decade or so making next month's Grand Theft Auto game had quite a bit of freedom to add details simply because they thought they might be cool.
paragraphs.cn: 这批《GTA6》幕后消息来自彭博社记者Jason Schreier。上周分享了一些重点内容后，他又进一步介绍了自己到访苏格兰爱丁堡Rockstar North办公室的见闻。这段18分钟的视频中，有一点颇值得关注：团队花了约十年时间制作这款将于下个月发售的《侠盗猎车手》新作，而在开发过程中，只要觉得某个细节可能很有趣，他们就有相当大的自由将其加入游戏。

paragraphs.en: Schreier said he'd guess that "not even top developers" at Rockstar know every tiny detail added to Vice City and its wealth of NPCs. He noted that giving large teams the autonomy to flesh out every street corner isn't too uncommon for open-world games. In the case of GTA 6 and its huge budget and lengthy development time, that means players will likely still be discovering new details even years down the road.
paragraphs.cn: Schreier表示，他猜测Rockstar「即便是最资深的开发者」，也不知道罪恶都市及其中众多NPC身上的每一处细节。他指出，在开放世界游戏开发中，让大型团队自主充实各个街头巷尾的细节，并不算少见。而《GTA6》预算庞大、开发周期漫长，玩家很可能在多年后仍能发现新细节。

paragraphs.en: Schreier shared a quote from Rockstar's Aaron Garbut, who said, "There's no one person that has this whole thing in their head." That's probably not too new for the GTA team, with the video also recalling one specific detail from Red Dead Redemption 2 .
paragraphs.cn: Schreier引用了Rockstar的Aaron Garbut的一句话：「没有任何一个人能在脑中装下这整款游戏的全部内容。」对《GTA》团队来说，这大概不算什么新鲜事，视频也回顾了《荒野大镖客：救赎2》中的一个具体细节。

paragraphs.en: Players may remember that horses found through the cowboy simulator had testicles with realistic physics. The thing fans still love to pass around to this day is the fact that they even shrink in colder weather.
paragraphs.cn: 玩家或许还记得，这款牛仔模拟游戏里的马匹，连睾丸都有逼真的物理效果。时至今日，粉丝仍津津乐道的是，它们甚至会在寒冷天气里收缩。

paragraphs.en: Garbut mentioned that this specific feature (if you can call it that) was not something Rockstar had on some big list of details to include in Red Dead Redemption 2, nor was it something the team was ever asked to spend extra time on. Instead, the shrinking horse testicles, like many other details in the 2018 Western sandbox game, was something that someone happened to have enough time to work on and bring to life. It's this same strategy that fans can expect to see implemented in GTA 6.
paragraphs.cn: Garbut提到，这项功能（如果能这么称呼的话）并不在Rockstar为《荒野大镖客：救赎2》准备的某份庞大细节清单上，团队也从未被要求额外花时间制作它。相反，与这款2018年西部沙盒游戏中的许多其他细节一样，马匹睾丸收缩只是因为有人恰好有足够的时间，便动手将其做了出来。粉丝可以期待《GTA6》也采用同样的做法。

paragraphs.en: Schreier's video also revealed that Rockstar spent quite a bit of time trying to do away with the weapon wheel it had leaned on in past games. Worried that slapping a game-y wheel on Jason and Lucia would remind players of what they can't carry on their person, they attempted to create a new system to replace it. The team then spent "months, if not years, trying a million different things." Examples listed include trays, webs, and UI updates for the formula before eventually, as we've seen , tossing all of those ideas out the window and going back to the traditional weapon wheel.
paragraphs.cn: Schreier的视频还透露，Rockstar花了相当长的时间，试图舍弃过去几款游戏一直沿用的武器轮盘。团队担心，给Jason和Lucia套上一个游戏感十足的轮盘，会提醒玩家，有些东西是角色无法随身携带的，因此尝试设计一套新系统来取代它。此后，团队「花了数月，甚至可能数年，尝试了无数种办法」。视频列举的方案包括托盘式、网状布局，以及在原有形式上调整UI。不过正如我们已经看到的，团队最终放弃了所有这些想法，回归传统的武器轮盘。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, as one might imagine could be the case over the course of developing a major video game, Rockstar's long path to launch wasn't without its roadblocks. Schreier said the "dark moments" of development saw the GTA 6 team struggle between the years of about 2019 to 2022. He said Rockstar's desire to balance the realism of Red Dead Redemption gameplay with the traditionally more arcade-y systems GTA is known for was the driving factor.
paragraphs.cn: 与此同时，不难想象，开发大型游戏的过程难免遇到障碍，Rockstar漫长的开发之路也不例外。Schreier表示，大约2019年至2022年是开发的「黑暗时期」，《GTA6》团队在这段时间举步维艰。他说，主要原因在于Rockstar希望在《荒野大镖客：救赎》玩法的真实感与《GTA》一贯以之著称的、更偏街机风格的系统之间取得平衡。

paragraphs.en: It was during this time that some team members felt they were just "treading water," leading the project to shed some designers before the vision really started coming together toward the beginning of 2023. According to Schreier's reporting, some Rockstar artists have been working on GTA 6 since 2015, just two years after the launch of GTA 5. It was this same year the team started taking trips to Miami to plot out their reimagined Vice City.
paragraphs.cn: 在这段时间里，一些团队成员觉得自己只是在「原地踏步」，因此有部分设计师离开了项目。直到2023年初前后，游戏的构想才真正开始成形。据Schreier报道，Rockstar的一些美术人员早在2015年就开始参与《GTA6》的开发，当时距离《GTA5》发售仅过去两年。团队也是从这一年开始前往迈阿密考察，为重新构想的罪恶都市做规划。

paragraphs.en: Now, after all this time, GTA 6 is exactly one month away (!) from its November 19, 2026, release date. To help hype up everyone who has waited 13 years to see if it was worth the long, long wait, Rockstar has taken over Miami. One recent example from its marketing push includes a collection of cars ripped straight out of the game .
paragraphs.cn: 如今，经过如此漫长的等待，距离《GTA6》在2026年11月19日发售恰好只剩一个月了（！）。玩家已经等了13年，想看看这段漫长的等待究竟值不值得，而Rockstar为点燃大家的热情，已经让宣传活动席卷迈阿密。最近的一项宣传活动，就展示了一批仿佛从游戏中直接开出来的汽车。

paragraphs.en: For more, you can check out new details and screenshots from the GTA 6 launch trailer . Rockstar has insisted it won't take another eight years to make its next game , but as we wait during these last 30 days for this one, you can read IGN's interview with Rob Nelson .
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar坚称，制作下一款游戏不会再花上八年。
